title.value: Learning a Universal Template for Few-shot Dataset Generalization
title.justification: The title is explicitly stated in the provided document.
title.quote: Learning a Universal Template for Few-shot Dataset Generalization

analysis.description: This paper focuses on few-shot dataset generalization, proposing a method called FLUTE (Few-shot Learning with a Universal TEmplate). The approach involves creating a universal template using a partially parameterized model that can be adapted to multiple datasets by specifying certain parameters, specifically using FiLM on batch normalization layers. This allows for parameter-efficient training and state-of-the-art performance on the Meta-Dataset benchmark.

type.justification: The paper conducts experimental evaluations to validate the performance of the proposed method FLUTE against other models on the Meta-Dataset benchmark.
type.quote: We experimentally evaluate FLUTE on few-shot dataset generalization using the recent Meta-Dataset benchmark.
